content_of_post_to_answer: How can people with ADHD balance the experience of flow and hyper-focus without being interrupted or distracted?
answer: People often treat hyper-focus as the goal, but for many with ADHD the real challenge is learning to create a bridge in and out of that state. Flow feels productive because attention finally locks in, yet the same mechanism can make transitions painful. The overlooked skill is not stopping focus; it is building gentle exit points before focus turns into lost time. The best systems protect deep attention while respecting the need to return to the rest of life.
